 USB charger will function only when engine is in running condition.
 Recommended not to use in rainy conditions to avoid damages to smart phones and charger, RE shall not be liable for any damage to smart phones.

 Only constant charging mode is provided, fast / dash charging mode is not provided to be compatible with multiple makes mobile phones and cannot be compared with the performance of original smartphone chargers.
 Charger port is located on the center part of handle bar.
 Duration of charging can be higher and will vary for different make mobile phones depending on smart phone battery capacity, SOC and smart phone charging circuits.
 Charging port is provided only for charging purpose and no data transfer is enabled.
 Do not insert any metal or conductive materials inside USB charging port which may lead to short circuit.
 Use standard approved and high quality USB cables for proper functioning.
 Ensure proper insertion of USB cable, damages due to hard / wrong insertion of cable will not be entertained in warranty.
 Customer to ensure USB port cap is closed and locked properly when not in use, warranty will not be provided if port cap is damaged and not sealed properly.
 If high current draw greater than 2.5 A is observed USB charger will shutdown please check your smart phone battery current ratings before using.
 Do not leave the USB port cap opened / closed partially to avoid any short circuit when not in use.
 Do not use any other device other than mobile phones, only one mobile shall be charged at one point of time.
Usage of fuses other than specified rating or usage of any other conductive materials or low grade fuses will damage the complete electrical system.
Please ensure to replace a spare fuse in the holder at the earliest opportunity.

Please get the electrical system of your motorcycle checked thoroughly and get the faults corrected immediately after experiencing any fuse failure. Failure to do so may result in repeated fuse failure.
Make sure the ignition switch is in "OFF" position when replacing the bulbs, fuses and electrical parts.
Any attempt to jumper a defective fuse gives rise to the risk of a short-circuit and fire. Always replace a defective fuse with a new fuse of the same rating.

readonly_1eca4f5973793c6d08817494.label: CHARGER PORT / DESCRIPTIVE SPECIFICATIONS AND COMPLETE LIMITATIONS

mandatory_display.text: The manual recommends avoiding charger use in rain to prevent damage to the phone and charger.
The port is limited to one mobile phone at a time; other devices are not permitted.
The USB cable must be inserted correctly; damage from hard or incorrect insertion is excluded from warranty.
An open or partly closed unused port cap creates a short-circuit risk.
Metal or conductive material inside the port can cause a short circuit.
The port cap must be closed and locked when unused; a damaged or improperly sealed cap is excluded from warranty.
The charger shuts down if current draw exceeds 2.5 A; the manual requires checking phone battery current ratings before use.
The charger functions only while the engine is running.
The manual specifies standard approved high-quality USB cables for proper function.
Electrical devices with ratings other than those specified can overload the electrical system, cause erratic behaviour or premature failure.
Unapproved modifications or fitments can seriously affect performance and void the warranty.

readonly_1175c97abf56afb93bcf584d.label: MINI BLADE FUSE USAGE LIST / TABLE READING ONLY

mandatory_display.text: Any fuse failure requires electrical-system inspection and correction; otherwise failures may repeat.
An unspecified fuse rating, conductive substitute or low-quality fuse can damage the complete electrical system.
The manual requires spare-fuse replenishment at the earliest opportunity.
Jumpering a defective fuse risks short circuit and fire; a replacement must retain the specified rating.
Replacement of bulbs, fuses or electrical parts requires ignition OFF.
